Tip: Check the bulletin board to spot trends. Which products should you buy and sell?

Tip: Invest in the inn to receive a steady daily income!
Tip: A random box contains 1 to 5 items. The box on the right holds slightly better items.
Tip: There are three types of merchants selling products: grocery merchants, processed goods merchants, and luxury goods merchants. The more expensive the item, the greater the price fluctuation.
Tip: There is only one luxury item in the game. If you have it, no other merchant will have that product!
Tip: Look for someone who asks to borrow coins. They are rumored to repay on time, albeit with interest.
Tip: Try wholesale purchasing at the inn. You can buy in bulk at a lower price, but you won't receive the goods on the same day.
Tip: Also try out the other modes available on the title screen! There are modes designed to ignite your competitive spirit!
Tip: After 100 days, your remaining coins are recorded, the game ends, and you are awarded diamonds based on the coin balance.
Tip: Merchants don't always sell every product. There might be days when they don't have what you're looking for.
Tip: Spend diamonds to upgrade your merchant rank. The higher your rank, the more abilities you can unlock.
